issue.title: [test_decap] [Broadcom] test_decap fails due to DSCP Uniform mode issue with IPinIP tunnel

failure.body:
#### Description

IPinIP tunnels programmed with DSCP Uniform mode in ASIC-DB are not taking effect on any of the Broadcom XGS platforms (except TD3).  The test failure is seen for IPv4 & IPv6 tunnels

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Run decap/test_decap.py on TH, TH2, TH3 or TD2 platform

#### Describe the results you received:
test_decap fails due to DSCP field from outer IP header not being retained

Sent Packet:
<IPV6>.437349 <IPV6> > <IPV6>, ethertype IPv4 (0x0800), length 77: (tos 0xc, ttl 64, id 1, offset 0, flags [none], proto IPIP (4), length 63)
    <IP> > <IP>: (tos 0x0, ttl 64, id 1, offset 0, flags [none], proto Options (0), length 43)
    <IP> > <IP>:  ip-proto-0 23
        0x0000:  c8f7 50ed 7cc1 caed 30a2 581c 0800 45**0c**  ..P.|...0.X...E.
        0x0010:  003f 0001 0000 4004 6e8c 0101 0101 0a01  .?....@.n.......
        0x0020:  0020 4500 002b 0001 0000 4000 77d1 0101  ..E..+....@.w...
        0x0030:  0101 0100 0000 536f 6e69 6320 6465 6361  ......Sonic.deca
        0x0040:  7020 6272 6f6b 656e 2074 6573 74         p.broken.test

Received Packet after decap:
<IPV6>.135576 <IPV6> > <IPV6>, ethertype IPv4 (0x0800), length 60: (tos 0x0, ttl 63, id 1, offset 0, flags [none], proto Options (0), length 43)
    <IP> > <IP>:  ip-proto-0 23
        0x0000:  5254 0080 cab7 c8f7 50ed 7cc1 0800 45**00**  RT......P.|...E.
        0x0010:  002b 0001 0000 3f00 78d1 0101 0101 0100  .+....?.x.......
        0x0020:  0000 536f 6e69 6320 6465 6361 7020 6272  ..Sonic.decap.br
        0x0030:  6f6b 656e 2074 6573 743e c22d            oken.test>.-

#### Describe the results you expected:
Since the tunnel is programmed to be in DSCP Uniform mode, expected the DSCP from outer IPv4 header to be retained and test case should pass

redis-dump -d 1 -k "ASIC_STATE:SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_TUNNEL:*" -y
{
  "ASIC_STATE:SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_TUNNEL:oid:0x2a0000000005a4": {
    "expireat": 1628282317.6948571,
    "ttl": -0.001,
    "type": "hash",
    "value": {
      **"SAI_TUNNEL_ATTR_DECAP_DSCP_MODE": "SAI_TUNNEL_DSCP_MODE_UNIFORM_MODEL",**
      "SAI_TUNNEL_ATTR_DECAP_ECN_MODE": "SAI_TUNNEL_DECAP_ECN_MODE_COPY_FROM_OUTER",
      "SAI_TUNNEL_ATTR_DECAP_TTL_MODE": "SAI_TUNNEL_TTL_MODE_PIPE_MODEL",
      "SAI_TUNNEL_ATTR_OVERLAY_INTERFACE": "oid:0x60000000005a3",
      "SAI_TUNNEL_ATTR_TYPE": "SAI_TUNNEL_TYPE_IPINIP",
      "SAI_TUNNEL_ATTR_UNDERLAY_INTERFACE": "oid:0x6000000000540"
    }
  },

Expected packet:
<IPV6>.135576 <IPV6> > <IPV6>, ethertype IPv4 (0x0800), length 60: (tos 0xc, ttl 63, id 1, offset 0, flags [none], proto Options (0), length 43)
    <IP> > <IP>:  ip-proto-0 23
        0x0000:  5254 0080 cab7 c8f7 50ed 7cc1 0800 45**0c**  RT......P.|...E.
        0x0010:  002b 0001 0000 3f00 78d1 0101 0101 0100  .+....?.x.......
        0x0020:  0000 536f 6e69 6320 6465 6361 7020 6272  ..Sonic.decap.br
        0x0030:  6f6b 656e 2074 6573 743e c22d            oken.test>.-
#### Output of `show version`:

```

Distribution: Debian 10.10

```

```

```

Case CS00012202914 has been filed with Broadcom to track this

resolution.title: [202012] BRCM SAI 4.5.3.1-4 Fixes dscp-uniform mode, th3 debug counter bmp crash
resolution.description:
This is to pick up BRCM SAI <IP>-3 fixes which contains the following fixes:
1.  CS00012209065: Fixing the debug counter failure with empty port bitmap (FDB flush failure)
2.  CS00012202914: Uniform DECAP IPinIP tunnel
3.  SID: SDK patches for SDK-260647 and  SDK-262523
4. SONIC-48981: Initialize default values for drop and mark probability

Preliminary tests looks fine. BGP neighbors were all up with proper routes programmed
interfaces are all up
Manually ran the following test cases on 7050CX3 (TD3) T0 DUT and all passed:
```
     ipfwd/test_dir_bcast.py
     fib/test_fib.py
     vxlan/test_vxlan_decap.py
     fdb/test_fdb.py
     vlan/test_vlan.py
     drop_packets/test_configurable_drop_counters.py
     decap/test_decap.py
     ipfwd/test_dip_sip.py
     ipfwd/test_dir_bcast.py
     ipfwd/test_mtu.py
     vlan/test_vlan.py
```
Also tested on TH3 T0 with
```
    drop_packets/test_drop_counters.py
```
